string-array.name: faq_questions
string-array.item: How can I browse the furniture catalog?
How do I add a product to my cart?
How do I place an order?
Do I need an account to shop?
What payment methods do you accept?
Can I visit your store in person?

string-array.name: faq_answers
string-array.item: Open the app and you will see all our available collections on the main screen. Tap any collection to explore the products inside.
Open a product, select your preferred variant (size, color, material, etc.), and tap "Add to Cart".
Once you have added items to your cart, tap the cart icon and then "Proceed to Checkout". You will be guided through our secure Shopify checkout.
You can browse the full catalog without an account. To complete a purchase and track your orders, you will need to sign in or create a free account.
We accept: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Mercado Pago, Kueski Pay, Atrato Pago, Aplazo, OXXO (cash at convenience stores), and Cash on Delivery.
Yes! We deliver to many locations. Shipping details and costs are calculated at checkout based on your address.
Absolutely! You can find us at Av. México 228, Col. Raúl Romero, Nezahualcóyotl, Estado de México. We are open every day — come say hello!
You can reach us via the WhatsApp button on any product page, or visit our website at mueblespaty.com. We are happy to help!
